universal_hygiene_finding.finding: no candidate source publishes a per-item or per-file content hash
universal_hygiene_finding.consequence: every source entering A0 requires us to compute and pin sha256 at the file and item level during ingest. This is now a normal, budgeted cost of the pipeline rather than an edge case.

provenance_rule: a third-party mirror's license tag is an unaffiliated claim. It is recorded as a claim, never adopted as a grant, and never used to resolve a conflict in the bank's favour.
